methodologyNote: Measured via page views across tracked network traffic.

aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome led browsers (mobile) in Netherlands at 68.95% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari ranked second at 20.66%, followed by Samsung Internet at 6.2%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in Netherlands?
faqs.answer: Chrome leads at 68.95% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/netherlands.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in Netherlands?
faqs.answer: Chrome (68.95%), Safari (20.66%), Samsung Internet (6.2%) in October 2026.
